title: devbin: parked until hv schedules
objective: Each devbin feature that hv has parked is a work package of this thread, not started. A package starts only on hv's word. The thread is done when each package has shipped, or has been dropped with hv's reason.
context:
hv's words of 2026-11-27, through devbin-vc (vc decision 335), move all unfinished work into a future, unstarted thread or work package. vc's hold 2 and todo 213 parked these features until hv schedules them:

- `--ivault`, which also waits on Intent's ST0060.
- The no-vendor mode, which waited for devbin to be public (vc decision 64).

Each package names hv's word as its start.
